harness_noise.note: Chromium's back-forward cache (bfcache) served a fully-hydrated but STALE copy of /my-listings/#favorites on a repeat browser_navigate to the identical URL - browser_network_requests showed ZERO network activity for that navigation, yet the DOM showed the just-removed favorite (badge '1', card present) while the DB (`listora_favorites`, 0 rows), the live REST API (GET /favorites -> total:0), and a manual fetch() with cache:'no-store' all agreed the favorite was correctly gone. This looked exactly like the classic 'counter disagrees with panel' bug (cross-cutting check 8) and would have been filed as one. Confirmed as a harness artifact by hopping through an intermediate URL to force a real navigation, which then rendered correctly (badge '0', empty state). Lesson for future walks on this harness: never trust a same-URL browser_navigate as a fresh read; either navigate through an intermediate page first or verify with a cache:'no-store' fetch before concluding a counter/panel disagreement is real.
harness_noise.cause: Playwright/Chromium back-forward cache, not a Listora defect. C.member.favorites is a genuine PASS.

resolved_failures.triage_note: wp_actionscheduler_actions has 15 rows with status=failed in group wb-listora-pro (hooks wb_listora_pro_expire_needs and wb_listora_pro_webhook_log_cleanup), message 'will not be executed as no callbacks are registered.' Root cause: these recurring actions were scheduled while their owning toggle (reverse_listings / outgoing_webhooks) was ON; the toggle was later flipped OFF, so Feature_Manager stopped instantiating the class and registering the hook callback, and the already-queued action fires into a void and fails. This is a real (if minor) gap in the toggle-off path - flipping a toggle off should probably also unschedule its recurring action, not just skip re-registering it. IMPORTANT: every failure timestamp is 2026-08-07 through 2026-09-09, i.e. this predates today's 1.8.0 walk by two weeks minimum, and zero NEW failed actions were added during this session (confirmed via debug.log byte-diff and re-query after the walk). Not a 1.8.0 regression - flagging for backlog triage, not as a release blocker for 1.8.0. Toggle-gated cron PRESENCE for the site's current toggle state (S8) is correct: only wb_listora_pro_audit_cleanup, wb_listora_pro_expire_needs and wb_listora_pro_license_check are PENDING/recurring right now, matching audit_log=ON, reverse_listings=ON, everything else OFF.
